userStories.title: Migrate existing DB rows: ready_to_merge → ready_for_merge
userStories.description: Add an idempotent SQL migration inside `_migrate_schema()` in `backend/app/database.py` that renames the state value `ready_to_merge` to `ready_for_merge` in both the `state` and `previous_state` columns of the `tickets` table. The migration must be safe to re-run (no rows will match after the first execution).
acceptanceCriteria: In `backend/app/database.py` `_migrate_schema()`: add `UPDATE tickets SET state = 'ready_for_merge' WHERE state = 'ready_to_merge'`
Same migration for `previous_state`: `UPDATE tickets SET previous_state = 'ready_for_merge' WHERE previous_state = 'ready_to_merge'`
Both UPDATE statements are idempotent (re-running produces no changes)

userStories.title: Update backend state machine: pickup → in_merge, complete → done
userStories.description:
Update the backend state machine constants so the merger agent works through `ready_for_merge → in_merge → done` instead of the old `ready_to_merge → done` path.

Changes required:
- `backend/app/agents.py`: change `AGENT_TYPES["merger"]["column_binding"]` from `"ready_to_merge"` to `"ready_for_merge"`
- `backend/app/agent_loop.py`: in `STATE_TO_AGENT` dict, rename key `"ready_to_merge"` to `"ready_for_merge"` (value stays `"merger"`)
- `backend/app/routers/agents.py`: change `PICKUP_NEXT_STATE["merger"]` from `"ready_to_merge"` to `"in_merge"`
- `backend/app/routers/agents.py`: remove `"ready_to_merge": "done"` from `COMPLETE_NEXT_STATE`, add `"in_merge": "done"` in its place
acceptanceCriteria: `backend/app/agent_loop.py`: `STATE_TO_AGENT` has key `"ready_for_merge"` mapping to `"merger"`; key `"ready_to_merge"` is removed
Golden path e2e test: POST pickup for merger agent → ticket state becomes `in_merge`; POST complete → ticket state becomes `done`

userStories.title: Update backend allowed transitions for new states
userStories.description:
Update `ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS` in `backend/app/routers/transitions.py` to reflect the new state sequence.

Required changes:
- `in_test` entry: replace `"ready_to_merge"` with `"ready_for_merge"` in the allowed set
- Remove the `"ready_to_merge"` entry entirely
- Add `"ready_for_merge": {"in_merge", "blocked"}`
- Add `"in_merge": {"done", "blocked"}`

userStories.title: Update dashboard metrics model and force-unlock routing
userStories.description:
Update `backend/app/routers/dashboard.py` in two places:

1. `ColumnCounts` Pydantic model: rename field `ready_to_merge` to `ready_for_merge`; add new field `in_merge: int = 0`.
2. `all_states` list in the `get_metrics` endpoint: replace `"ready_to_merge"` with `"ready_for_merge"` and add `"in_merge"`.
3. `_UNLOCK_TARGET` dict: rename `"ready_to_merge": "ready_to_merge"` to `"ready_for_merge": "ready_for_merge"`; add `"in_merge": "ready_for_merge"` so force-unlocking an in-merge ticket returns it to the queue.
acceptanceCriteria: Force-unlocking a ticket in state `in_merge` returns it to `ready_for_merge`
Golden path e2e test: create ticket in `in_merge`, call force-unlock, verify state is `ready_for_merge`

userStories.title: Update frontend board columns: add in_merge, rename ready_for_merge
userStories.description:
Update `frontend/src/types.ts` to replace the old `ready_to_merge` column with two new columns in the `COLUMNS` array.

Remove:
```typescript
{ key: 'ready_to_merge', label: 'Ready to Merge' }
```
Add in its place (in the same position, before `done`):
```typescript
{ key: 'ready_for_merge', label: 'Ready for Merge' },
{ key: 'in_merge', label: 'In Merge' },
```
The pipeline order on the board should be: `… In Test | Ready for Merge | In Merge | Done`.
acceptanceCriteria: `COLUMNS` array contains `{ key: 'ready_for_merge', label: 'Ready for Merge' }` positioned after `in_test` and before `{ key: 'in_merge', ... }`
`COLUMNS` array contains `{ key: 'in_merge', label: 'In Merge' }` positioned after `ready_for_merge` and before `done`
Verify in browser: board shows two columns 'Ready for Merge' and 'In Merge' in the correct order

userStories.title: Update frontend drag-drop allowed transitions
userStories.description:
Update `ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS` in `frontend/src/drag-drop.ts` to mirror the new backend state machine.

Required changes:
- `in_test` entry: replace `'ready_to_merge'` with `'ready_for_merge'` in the allowed array
- Remove the `ready_to_merge` entry entirely
- Add `ready_for_merge: ['in_merge', 'blocked']`
- Add `in_merge: ['done', 'blocked']`
- In the `blocked` entry's allowed array: replace `'ready_to_merge'` with `'ready_for_merge'` and add `'in_merge'`
acceptanceCriteria: Verify in browser: dragging ticket from In Test to Ready for Merge is accepted; dragging from Ready for Merge to In Merge is accepted; dragging from In Merge to Done is accepted

userStories.title: Update dashboard column labels for new states
userStories.description:
Update the column label map in `frontend/src/dashboard.ts` to reflect the renamed and new states. Find the `COLUMN_LABELS` object (or equivalent label lookup) and:
- Remove `ready_to_merge: 'Ready to Merge'`
- Add `ready_for_merge: 'Ready for Merge'`
- Add `in_merge: 'In Merge'`
acceptanceCriteria: Verify in browser: dashboard column headings show 'Ready for Merge' and 'In Merge' (not 'Ready to Merge')

userStories.title: Update frontend test fixtures for new state names
userStories.description:
Update test fixture data in the frontend test suite so the TypeScript compile and test suite remain green after the state rename.

- `frontend/src/drag-drop.test.ts`: replace all `ready_to_merge` references with `ready_for_merge`; add test cases for `in_merge` transitions (e.g. `ready_for_merge → in_merge` is allowed, `in_merge → done` is allowed)
- `frontend/src/dashboard.test.ts`: in any `ColumnCounts` fixtures, rename field `ready_to_merge: 0` to `ready_for_merge: 0` and add `in_merge: 0`
